purpose: Construct the four source-defined Community viability predicates as distinct, traceable, unevaluated records without deciding their truth.

required.statement: Accept an opaque Community state and source-addressable opaque bounds for the four source-defined viability predicates.
Produce exactly four distinct unevaluated predicate records while preserving source order, inclusive comparator notation, opaque payloads, provenance, unresolved items, and reservations.
Expose no successful partial result after any validation or preservation failure.

forbidden.statement: Do not numerically compare bounds, decide predicate truth, or produce an aggregate viability Boolean.
Do not infer collapse, pathology, transition, initial-state, terminal-state, solver, discretization, unit, tolerance, or scientific default semantics.
Do not mutate the supplied state, bounds, or external scientific state.

deferred.statement: Time semantics, the graph operator, norm semantics, memory notation, and final scientific output semantics remain preserved unresolved.
Concrete runtime representation and scientific evaluation remain outside this package.

operations.purpose: Validate and package the four viability constraints without scientific evaluation.

inputs.name: community_state
inputs.semantic_role: opaque Community state referenced by every predicate

constraints.statement: The carrier must preserve OpaqueCommunityState identity and payload without evaluation.

inputs.name: bounds
inputs.semantic_role: source-addressable opaque bounds for the four viability predicates

constraints.statement: Every predicate and bound source identifier must be known and all four predicates must remain distinct.
The output contains exactly four source-defined records and no truth value or aggregate viability result.

preconditions.statement: Every predicate, bound, object, and relation identifier exists in the Dynamics inventory.
The state and bounds preserve their declared opaque carrier shapes.

postconditions.statement: Exactly four distinct predicate records are present in source order with inclusive comparator notation preserved.
All opaque payloads, unresolved items, reservations, and source links are unchanged.
No predicate truth or aggregate viability result exists.

invariants.statement: Opaque payloads are never evaluated or mutated.

steps: attach traceability unresolved items and reservations

partial_order.before: attach traceability unresolved items and reservations

prescription_basis: Validation, preservation, and atomic publication are observable; the upstream total step list does not prescribe a unique internal algorithm.

error_contract.condition: A predicate, bound, object, or relation identifier is not known to the authoritative Dynamics inventory.
The Community state or viability-bounds carrier does not preserve its declared shape.
Scientific truth evaluation, aggregate viability, collapse, or transition semantics are requested although the required science is unresolved.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose four distinct unevaluated predicate records and stable errors.
Do not decide viability truth or infer transition semantics.
Any internal architecture is allowed when observable obligations are preserved.

global_invariants.statement: Absence of scientific definition remains absence and never becomes a default.
No implementation may weaken identity, order, opacity, traceability, unresolved preservation, or failure atomicity.

notes: Conformance is behavioral and does not prescribe a language, public function spelling, serialization, or internal algorithm.
